description: PHASE 4 Integration Validation: Generate TypeScript snapshot, fix integration tests, verify complete test suite passes. Generates snapshot.json using TypeScript discovery CLI, updates test expectations for snapshot-dependent tests, runs full test suite to verify 241+ tests passing with 0 failures. This feature validates all prior FEAT implementations work together correctly and meet the M2 completion criteria.
steps: 1. Generate TypeScript snapshot by running: pnpm --filter @quiz/project-llm-discovery scan (creates packages/project-llm-discovery/output/snapshot.json)
2. Verify snapshot generated successfully: check file exists at packages/project-llm-discovery/output/snapshot.json and contains schemaVersion, repository, structure, blocks, evidence fields
3. Run TypeScript discovery tests: pnpm --filter @quiz/project-llm-discovery test to verify 220/220 tests pass
4. Run Python integration tests: cd services/project-ai && pytest tests/integration/ -v to identify failing tests due to missing snapshot
5. Fix test_i2_e2e_certification.py if failing: update test expectations to handle snapshot availability, ensure test checks for CERTIFYING or FAILED state based on snapshot presence
6. Run previously skipped snapshot-dependent tests: cd services/project-ai && pytest tests/ -v (no -k filter) to execute all tests including previously skipped ones
7. Verify test count: cd services/project-ai && pytest tests/ --collect-only to confirm 241+ tests discovered
8. Run full Python test suite: cd services/project-ai && pytest tests/ -v and verify 241+ tests pass, 0 failures, 0-6 skipped (only external service-dependent tests)
9. Verify evidence directory structure created: ls -la .project-ai/runs/ to confirm directory exists (may be empty if no runs executed yet)

10. Verify agent handlers wired: cd services/project-ai && python -c 'from app.orchestration.agent_coordinator import AgentCoordinator; c = AgentCoordinator(); print("Agent dispatch ready")' to confirm imports work

11. Run cross-feature integration check: generate test run directory using EvidenceLogger, execute one agent handler, log results, verify JSON files created with correct structure and 2-space indentation
12. Final verification: pnpm --filter @quiz/project-llm-discovery test && cd services/project-ai && pytest tests/ -v to confirm entire test suite passes
acceptance_criteria: packages/project-llm-discovery/output/snapshot.json exists and is valid (contains schemaVersion 1.1.0, 842 evidence records)

Full Python test suite passes: 241+ tests, 0 failures, 0-6 skipped (only justified external service dependencies)
.project-ai/runs/ directory exists (created by FEAT-001 evidence logger)
All agent handlers importable and dispatch mechanism functional (verified by import check)
Cross-feature integration works: EvidenceLogger + agent execution + result logging produces valid JSON files
Complete test suite verification: pnpm test (TypeScript) && pytest (Python) both pass with 100% pass rate on non-skipped tests
verification: cd services/project-ai && pytest tests/ --collect-only | grep 'test session starts'
